title: Classic Amatriciana Pasta
description: A hearty Italian pasta dish made with guanciale, tomatoes, and Pecorino cheese. Amatriciana is a classic Roman recipe that is easy to make and packed with flavor.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, cook the guanciale over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the guanciale from the skillet and set aside.
Add the lively amatriciana sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked spaghetti to the skillet and toss with the sauce.
Return the guanciale to the skillet and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and top with Pecorino Romano cheese.
